240-574-1849-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-1849-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

3240-5632-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4490-8173--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-8173--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Lyra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-8173--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

2511-3129-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2511-3129-5254.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

1844-5571-6495--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least X.
1844-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Fateful Handoff to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1844-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

567-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3197-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4381--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-5256-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

457-1458-4404-7183.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-7183.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Gathering Stone.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-4924-7043.description:
Cast Aang by paying {W}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-6797-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6797-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-6797-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

423-1257-1437-1671--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1257-1437-1671--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2342-3169-4659-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Shaman en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1251-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
1251-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1114-4094-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1114-4094-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Wrenn and Realmbreaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

1017-3532-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3532-3581-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3581-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1734-3817-5686.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2390-2919-4519.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give All Will Be One lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
2390-2919-4519.description:
Cast Dance of the Manse by paying {6}{W}{U}, returning All Will Be One from your graveyard to the battlefield as a creature.
Give All Will Be One lifelink.
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

560-671-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
560-671-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4871-5256-6291.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1692-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-4779-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

710-2730-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-4249-4832.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-4249-4832.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
478-804-2821-4249-4832.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 2.

654-880-5671.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2-2034-4365-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

527-1322-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-1322-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

123-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Highspire Artisan, adding {C}{C}.
When Highspire Artisan dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Highspire Artisan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Highspire Artisan enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

567-1981-3000-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1981-3000-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier and fifty 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
When the Soldiers and Squirrels enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

2034-3902-5199.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Saber Ants indestructible.
2034-3902-5199.description:
Give Saber Ants indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Saber Ants.
Saber Ants triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Saber Ants.
Repeat from step 4.

283-512-2872.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Clever Conjurer.
283-512-2872.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, coping Clever Conjurer' ability, targetting the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve both Clever Conjurer abilities, untapping Halo Fountain and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Clever Conjurer, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

1978-3789-5116.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as a 1/1 creature due to Godhead of Awe, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Pincher.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

579-2645-3068.notablePrerequisites: Jenson does not have summoning sickness.
579-2645-3068.description:
Activate Jenson by paying {5} and tapping it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Jenson.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Clever Impersonator, adding one mana of any color.
Clever Impersonator dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, returning Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spark Double, adding one mana of any color.
Spark Double dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

2011-3970-5168.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
2011-3970-5168.description:
Attack with Najeela, Bloom Tender, and Militia Rallier.
Najeela and Militia Rallier trigger.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Militia Rallier trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

777-1292-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

215-3291-3480-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters.
215-3291-3480-3771.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2493-3632-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
